author: Warhammer
description:
The Grey Knights are the elite daemon hunters of the Imperium! They rock an awesome silver colour scheme, which is super easy to paint and yet looks great. Tune in to see Ollie talk about all things painting Grey Knights.

Here’s a list of the paints we used in today’s video:

Base:
Abaddon Black
Corax White
Leadbelcher
Mephiston Red
Retributor Armour

Layer:
Dark Reaper
Liberator Gold
Pallid Wych Flesh
Stormhost Silver
White Scar
Wild Rider Red

Shade:
Drakenhof Nightshade
Nuln Oil

Contrast:
Aethermatic Blue

Technical:
Lahmian Medium

Tools:
S Base
M Layer
S Dry
M Shade
L Base
S Layer

If you enjoyed this and want to learn more, our YouTube channel has an array of beginner-friendly videos to get you started.
